description: This PHP class represents an entity for employee location mapping in the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It defines a many-to-one relationship between employees and locations, with methods to get and set these properties.

classes.name: EmpLocations
classes.description: Entity class representing the link between an employee and a location in the system, with properties for employee and location and corresponding accessors and mutators.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this location record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for this location record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location object associated with this employee.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the Location object for this employee.
